text:
Situation: Remifentanil hydrochloride 2 mg/2 mL, 5 mL vials (NDC 00143939210) are in short supply at Corvale Lakeside (6.8 days on hand). Corvale General holds 130 vials (16.5 days) and can transfer 16 vials while retaining 14 days of supply. The product is labeled by Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. and manufactured at Hospira, Inc. (FEI 1925262) and Navinta LLC (FEI 3004375014).

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the remifentanil hydrochloride shortage on 2022-06-28 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21. Affected manufacturers listed are Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., and Mylan Institutional, a Viatris Company. FDA inspection 976095 at Hospira, Inc. ended 2016-06-08 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2016-09-06. FDA's OAI classification letter to Navinta LLC is dated 2018-04-20, 1530 days before the shortage posting. FDA inspection 1064827 at Hospira, Inc. ended 2018-08-15 and was classified OAI, with the classification letter dated 2020-04-22, 797 days before the shortage posting.

Our position: We can mitigate the Lakeside gap immediately through an internal transfer while maintaining adequate stock at General. No clinical alternatives are proposed; dosing decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 16 vials of remifentanil hydrochloride 2 mg/2 mL, 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — approved by Pharmacy Director; executed via DEA Form 222 or CSOS order (Schedule II).
2. Monitor daily usage at both sites and report inventory positions to the P&T Committee weekly — approved by Pharmacy Director.
3. Request updated allocation schedules from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. and evaluate secondary distributors — approved by Pharmacy Director and P&T Committee.

Not recommended: Purchasing from unverified gray-market sources; initiating protocol changes without committee review.
